text:
No hiring option can be put forward from this run, because the £400k salary constraint was not assessable and the comparison is very fragile.

- The analysis treats all underlying values as Olumi-authored provisional estimates, not user evidence. Small assumption changes can alter the ordering; platform delivery capacity is the most sensitive model factor.
- The Q3-shipping objective was also ranked as “higher is better” without an explicitly stated goal direction.
- The salary limit remains in the model but was excluded: annual salary spend is modelled as a change, not a comparable £/year level. So this run does not establish whether any option stays under **£400k/year**.
